title.narrative: Emergency Response for Cholera and Dengue Fever Outbreaks in Gutina Locality - White Nile state

description.narrative: The ongoing insecurity in parts of White Nile State has worsened the health crisis in Gutina. Population displacement, restricted mobility, and disruptions to supply chains are limiting community access to healthcare. It has recently reported an increase in suspected cases of Dangu Fever (local term for acute febrile illness, possibly linked to vector-borne or communicable disease outbreaks). The condition is characterized by high fever, severe headache, muscle pain, and fatigue. Limited health infrastructure, poor sanitation, and low community awareness have contributed to the rapid spread and delayed treatment. According to the World Health Organization (WHO) report dated 1 September 2025, a total of 62 cases of dengue fever were reported last week. The cases were spread across different areas in Gutina.” The outbreak poses a serious public health risk, particularly in vulnerable groups such as children, women, and the elderly.
